material_errors.image_says: 西接魯城二百餘步之舊宅也 — the temple IS the old residence, which borders the Lu city wall at a distance of 200-odd paces to the west

material_errors.image_says: 仁宗御書飛帛殿榜之殿 — the hall whose plaque Renzong wrote in 'flying-white' (feibai) calligraphy

material_errors.english: Dharma Heirs of Zen Master Zhifeng of Jinfeng
material_errors.image_says: 金峯志禪師法嗣 (Dharma heirs of Chan Master Zhi of Jinfeng; his name is Zhi, not Zhifeng)

material_errors.image_says: 泌與馬燧疾驅而前將佐不俟抱暉之命來迎泌笑曰吾事濟矣去城十五里 (Mi and Ma Sui rode fast ahead; the officers came out to meet Mi without waiting for Baohui's order; Mi laughed and said 'My business is accomplished.' Fifteen li from the city…)
